mission: Build Universal Round U.4 as the first support-specific layer for MathTeach, grounding ADHD-aware, dyscalculia-aware, dyslexia-aware, autism-spectrum-aware, and language-sensitive tutoring without turning the system into diagnosis or therapy.
collection_principles: Treat support-specific design as instructional adaptation rather than diagnosis or identity assignment.
Prefer official educational and health guidance plus strongly cited reviews with direct classroom or tutoring implications.
Translate every source into response axes such as pacing, notation density, text load, visual structure, and feedback style.
Keep support families interoperable so later mixed-profile learners can be handled compositionally.

domains.name: ADHD-Aware Support
domains.goal: Adapt pacing, transitions, self-check rhythm, and external structure for attention and executive-function challenges.

domains.name: Dyscalculia-Aware Support
domains.goal: Adapt number-sense support, representation choice, and concrete-to-symbolic progression for math-specific learning barriers.

domains.name: Dyslexia-Aware Support
domains.goal: Reduce reading and decoding barriers in mathematical explanation, notation, and text-heavy problem solving.

domains.name: Autism-Spectrum-Aware Support
domains.goal: Use predictable structure, visual supports, and reduced uncertainty and sensory friction where needed.

domains.name: ELL and Language-Sensitive Support
domains.goal: Support multilingual learners by coupling mathematical meaning with academic-language scaffolds.

starter_sources.title: ADHD in the Classroom: Helping Children Succeed in School
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Direct official anchor for structure, accommodations, transitions, behavioral supports, and school-relevant adaptation.

starter_sources.title: Non-pharmacological interventions for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) delivered in school settings: systematic reviews of quantitative and qualitative research
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Large review focused specifically on school-delivered ADHD interventions, useful for tutoring implications beyond medication.

starter_sources.title: Genetics of childhood disorders: XVII. ADHD, Part 1: The executive functions and ADHD
starter_sources.organization: Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Compact classic anchor for executive-function framing that helps interpret why external structure can be instructionally necessary.

starter_sources.title: Dyscalculia: from brain to education
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Strong bridge source from numerical cognition to educational consequences, useful for avoiding simplistic 'just practice more' logic.

starter_sources.title: Developmental dyscalculia and basic numerical capacities: a study of 8-9-year-old students
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Foundational empirical anchor connecting low arithmetic attainment to basic numerical-capacity differences.

starter_sources.title: Infographic: Does your child struggle with Math? Dyscalculia could be the reason.
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Useful official framing source for non-stigmatizing public explanation and first-pass tutor language constraints.

starter_sources.title: Reading and Reading Disorders
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Official anchor for reading-load and decoding barriers that can spill into mathematics tutoring and word-problem comprehension.

starter_sources.title: Dyslexia (specific reading disability)
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Classic review for phonological-processing barriers, with clear implications for mathematical language and symbol decoding.

starter_sources.title: Treatment and Intervention for Autism Spectrum Disorder
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Official anchor that explicitly includes educational approaches and highlights consistency, structure, and visual-learning implications.

starter_sources.title: Visual supports at home and in the community for individuals with autism spectrum disorders: A scoping review
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Useful synthesis for predictability, visual supports, participation, and individualized structuring as general design signals.

starter_sources.title: Issues in the use of visual supports to promote communication in individuals with autism spectrum disorder
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Helpful review for the strengths and limits of visual supports, avoiding naive one-tool-fits-all design.

starter_sources.title: Teaching Academic Content and Literacy to English Learners in Elementary and Middle School
starter_sources.organization: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Strong official guide for integrating academic language support into content teaching, directly relevant to mathematics explanation.

starter_sources.title: Successful teaching practices for English language learners in multilingual mathematics classrooms: a meta-analysis
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Direct mathematics-specific synthesis for multilingual classrooms, useful for linking language support with mathematical access.
